build:fixtures.command: ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/wasm/fixtures/cli.zena -o tests/wasm/fixtures/cli.wasm && ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/extensions/fixtures/child.zena -o tests/extensions/fixtures/child.wasm --target component --wit tests/extensions/fixtures/child.wit --world child && ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/extensions/fixtures/plain.zena -o tests/extensions/fixtures/plain.wasm --target component --wit tests/extensions/fixtures/child.wit --world plain-world && ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/extensions/fixtures/random.zena -o tests/extensions/fixtures/random.wasm --target component --wit tests/extensions/fixtures/child.wit --world random-world && ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/extensions/fixtures/mismatch.zena -o tests/extensions/fixtures/mismatch.wasm --target component --wit tests/extensions/fixtures/mismatch.wit --world mismatch && ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/extensions/fixtures/relay.zena -o tests/extensions/fixtures/relay.wasm --target component --wit tests/extensions/fixtures/child.wit --world relay-world && ../../target/release/zena-cli build tests/extensions/fixtures/caller.zena -o tests/extensions/fixtures/caller.wasm --target component --wit tests/extensions/fixtures/caller.wit --world caller --extension-wit tests/extensions/fixtures/child.wit
build:fixtures.//: The zena:wasm tests run a component that talks to WASI; the host runs components only, so it is compiled from Zena rather than written by hand like the fixtures that need no host. The zena:extensions tests load components built against declared worlds (tests/extensions/fixtures), and run a caller that imports one of them, which a test file cannot declare.

check:wasi-wit.//: The vendored WASI WIT under zena/wit/ must match what the corpus wit-corpus.json pins renders to: a difference means a vendored file was edited by hand, or the pin moved without the script being re-run.
